thread:
maria: Quick question — onboarding a dedicated customer (AcmeHealth). Their side proxy is sending full Authorization headers and user emails in the request metadata and they want us to capture full request/response payloads for 48h to debug a latency/regression. Is temporary full capture acceptable? Who needs to sign off?

ashwin.k: We should avoid storing raw tokens/PHI. Options: ephemeral capture with HMAC of tokens, or mask tokens except a small prefix/suffix, or provide live debugging session where customer can repro while we stream. Need business justification and exact fields they need.

lisa: Security POV: We can approve a limited window but with strict controls — capture only on the dedicated tenant node, retention <= 72h (prefer 48h), time-bound IAM for access, and audit logs for every read. Also require a scrub/rotation plan immediately after capture. Please include S3 path + who exactly needs access. :lock:

tom_b: Ops follow-up — we can enable an "ephemeral_debug" flag that stores raw bodies for 1hr and hashed tokens for the rest, or a full-raw mode limited to a specific slice of traffic (e.g., sampling 1:10) to reduce exposure. We can also spin an isolated debug instance if AcmeHealth is large. Need CIDR/customer contact.

maria: Thanks. Customer insists raw traces to reproduce user session. They're in healthcare, so PHI likely present. I'll propose: 48h capture, HMAC of tokens (customer provides salt?), upload to locked S3 prefixed with customer id, access only via time-bound role, and automatic purge after 48h. Creating ticket INC-2345 with details now. @lisa can you prepare temp role?

lisa: I will create a redwood-temp-acme role with MFA + approval workflow. Because this is PHI we also need legal sign-off and a DPA amendment. Tagging legal.

jordan: On legal — assign to me. We need explicit written consent and DPA addendum that covers temporary capture. Approve conditionally if consent + retention <=48h + audit trail + no downstream retention. Also require customer to acknowledge their responsibility for any PHI exposure during debugging.

maria: Plan in ticket: 48h capture window, HMAC tokens, s3://acme-debug/INC-2345/, role redwood-temp-acme, access logs enabled, legal consent attached. I'll send customer the consent form and schedule start after legal signs off. Closing this thread unless someone objects. :white_check_mark:
